scope: Broad desk screen of existing drugs, human-characterized assets, local delivery and repurposing; 18 estimated development packages.
screen_status: Provisional estimated comparison; no asset promoted to funded development and no high-probability capital recovery substantiated.

methodology.primary_objective: Expected marginal financial value retained by the investor, subject to survivable loss and continuation constraints. Technical success is informative but does not substitute for capture or cash realization.
methodology.ranking_basis: Conditional desk priorities under modest option/co-development entry assumptions, existing academic/specialist execution and a funded handoff route. Not a numerical expected-return ranking: credible asset-specific sale prices and investor fractions are not yet known.
methodology.breadth: Four requested incumbents plus fourteen distinct routes, including familiar indications, product/territory transfers, rescue assets and lower-ranked negatives. Mavoglurant and saracatinib repeat concurrent PR3 work rather than claiming novelty.
methodology.cost_definition: USD low/base/high scenario sums of execution/CMC/operator/analysis/contingency plus explicit entry/rights/data/supply allowance. These are analyst assumptions, not quotes or price observations. Clinical estimates presume qualified investigators and existing infrastructure; no assumption that the investor is a qualified operator.
methodology.rights_assumption: Entry allowances buy a limited option, territory or contracted contribution interest, not global ownership. Legal diligence, supply/data agreements and initial option/entry payments are included; future royalties, milestones, dilution and follow-on capital must be deducted from investor proceeds separately.
methodology.large_fee_sensitivity: If an additional material acquisition fee or uncapped development obligation is required, recompute the whole opportunity; do not conceal this in the experimental budget or treat the present high case as a ceiling.
methodology.probability_definition: Subjective interval for a usable favorable result sufficient to change an advance/partner decision conditional on lawful article/data access and qualified execution, with recruitment and operational risk included. Not chance any data are generated, approval, commercial deal, principal recovery or guaranteed positive return. Decisive negative results can avoid future loss but are not counted as favorable outcomes.
methodology.probability_basis: Broad judgment anchored to exact-use human evidence, comparator quality, article bridge, endpoint relevance and execution complexity; no conversion of small-case response fractions into probabilities. APR and erlotinib use identical assumptions until distinguishing matched evidence is available.
methodology.scale_calibration: Root checked historical HHS/ASPE clinical-trial costs and NIH PAR-25-059 translational scopes as scale checks. Neither establishes these present-day candidate costs. No small pilot is described as complete sponsor phaseII/III, GMP/GLP or approval package.
methodology.cash_model: A proposed license, option assignment, contracted milestone or equity realization is a scenario, not offered revenue. Positive data with no transaction can yield no cash. An economic comparison must include investor share, senior claims, downstream obligations, delay, taxes/transaction costs and no-deal/no-follow-on-finance branches.
methodology.continuation_rule: Cap the initial commitment and use staged stop points. No obligation to fund the rest of a program; if follow-on financing is unavailable, consider sale/license/cessation with potentially zero recovery. Preserve losses already incurred when checking total risk limits, but treat them as sunk for forward value.
methodology.missing_offer_policy: Missing current quotes and offers widen uncertainty and motivate sensitivity; they do not screen out candidates automatically. Known exclusive rights or competing programs change route and capture assumptions, not biological evidence.
limitations: This is a broad source-informed screen, not legal FTO, patent validity, regulatory advice, a current CRO quote, or a validated financial model.
Some inherited candidate primary texts were already audited in repo; source records identify those rather than implying new human evidence.
For lower-ranked rows one or two sources bound a thesis; finalist evidence has multiple independent/contrary sources.
Nifedipine ranks as a potentially transferable product package, not because a small bridge assures US approval.
No asset-specific actual purchase offer was found in this pass; ordinary product retail prices would not price a commercial interest.
methodology.paid_handoff_probability: Low/base/high five-year conditional cash-event probabilities are explicitly subjective and very-low-confidence. They do not require an offer for desk comparison, and do not establish likelihood of full principal recovery. Milestone probability times conditional cash probability needs no independence assumption. Both are conditional on modeled obtainable access/rights; diligence can reveal that condition is false.
methodology.break_even_interpretation: For a scenario C/(p_m*p_cash), the result is required net retained cash conditional on both favorable milestone and timely paid realization, not a forecast transaction valuation. It omits discounting, interim cash, downside recoveries, future investor contributions and variable sale fractions unless added separately. Failure/financing-unavailable branches may return zero.
methodology.antrolin_status_scope: Current product-holder/manufacturing evidence used here is the May30,2026 Italian official notice. The Malta listing was not used as proof of current authorization; it is marked expired. The 2026 trial used a different lidocaine concentration and mixed acute/chronic population from historical Antrolin evidence.

shortlist_rationale: Carry nifedipine's existing-product/territory route and the matched APR/erlotinib function-oriented pair into deeper desk comparison. No robust evidence orders APR versus erlotinib financially under equal terms. Nifedipine's regulatory precedent could demote it if a partner-funded path is implausible. Rectal tacrolimus and 5-FU/calcipotriol are useful commercial-route challengers, with active-comparator/safety and exclusive-incumbent constraints respectively.

sources.title: Aprea Therapeutics Form 10-Q for September 30, 2026
sources.verified_fact: Aprea reports no ongoing APR-246 clinical trials and continuing patent-maintenance, regulatory and program-closeout expenditure. It describes public-domain eprenetapopt structure alongside method-of-use, formulation and other patent interests.
sources.limit: Issuer filing establishes reported program and intellectual-property context, not available licensing terms, ownership clearance for an AEC product, an asset offer or willingness to pay for a contribution.

sources.title: Improvement of epidermal covering on AEC patients with severe skin erosions by PRIMA-1MET/APR-246
sources.verified_fact: The original report describes two AEC children, including an APR-treated palm versus contralateral vehicle in one child and uncontrolled scalp treatment in the other, and identifies institutional clinical/formulation contributors.
sources.limit: The small nonrandomized, unblinded exploratory report does not establish a response probability, currently transferable article, available data rights or commercial permission.

sources.title: Sol-Gel current pipeline
sources.verified_fact: The live pipeline identifies SGT-210 as topical erlotinib, lists Phase I completion and describes further evaluation in additional indications.
sources.limit: Sponsor summary does not establish exact KRT16 efficacy, equivalence to the published compounded article, an available license or a paid development opportunity.

sources.title: Sol-Gel corporate overview, October 2026
sources.verified_fact: The October 2026 presentation positions the SGT-210 topical-erlotinib platform for small feasibility studies in new unmet-need indications.
sources.limit: A stated development plan supplies commercial-fit context, not an investment offer, quotation, payment commitment or evidence for the exact KRT16 population.

sources.title: Sol-Gel update after unblinding SGT-210 Phase 1b Darier study
sources.verified_fact: The release reports no differentiation between SGT-210 and vehicle on Darier efficacy assessments, no advancement in that indication, and an intention to pursue small feasibility studies elsewhere.
sources.limit: The actual release date is December 17, 2025; September 30, 2026 appears in page chrome and is not the event date. Darier findings cannot be transferred as exact KRT16 success or failure.

sources.title: IDHIFA U.S. prescribing information
sources.verified_fact: BMS labeling identifies enasidenib as an adult IDH2-mutant relapsed/refractory AML treatment and says pediatric safety and effectiveness have not been established.
sources.limit: The approved adult article does not establish D2HGA2 approval, suitability of an infant presentation, available clinical supply or commercial rights for a new indication.

sources.title: Enasidenib treatment in two individuals with D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria carrying a germline IDH2 mutation
sources.verified_fact: The primary publication reports treatment of two children with germline IDH2-associated D2HGA2, supporting a clinical indication-development question.
sources.limit: The freshly retrieved publisher abstract supports the broad clinical rationale; the full body was not recovered in this pass. This is not a new cohort, controlled efficacy estimate or investment probability.

sources.title: EP4058028B1: Pediatric formulations for treatment of cancer
sources.verified_fact: The EPO grant publication names Celgene Corporation as proprietor and describes pediatric enasidenib minitablet formulation work.
sources.limit: The published grant is not a current assignment-chain or enforceability check, freedom-to-operate conclusion, authenticated clinical-lot identity, supply commitment or license offer.

sources.title: ddiscov Round 26 local-product screen: inherited KRT16 evidence
sources.verified_fact: The repository records the KRT16 Arg127Cys erlotinib evidence as two related people with controlled opposite-foot phases and later uncontrolled improvement, preserving co-treatment and article limitations.
sources.limit: Inherited candidate dossier, not fresh clinical evidence. The primary author-copy PDF returned an access error in this pass; no new outcome, responder count or causal estimate is added.

sources.title: Calcipotriol plus 5-FU randomized actinic keratosis trial
sources.verified_fact: In 131 participants, four-day combination treatment reduced AK counts more than four-day 5-FU/vehicle control.
sources.limit: Control was not the usual multiweek 5-FU course; investigational admixture cannot be assumed equivalent to a fixed commercial cream.

sources.title: SKNV announces exclusive WashU fluorouracil/calcipotriene sublicense
sources.verified_fact: SKNV says it holds exclusive commercialization rights under a sublicense to WashU patents and sells Kefunova through its 503B outsourcing facility.
sources.limit: Issuer account, not an available sublicense or investment offer; a compounded product is not an FDA-approved combination drug.

sources.title: NCI standard-fluorouracil versus combination trial
sources.verified_fact: NCI lists active NCT06851507 comparing topical fluorouracil with fluorouracil/calcipotriene.
sources.limit: Active registry entry is not an efficacy result; future public information could reduce the value of duplicate privately funded work.

sources.title: Nifedipine/lidocaine versus active control in chronic anal fissure
sources.verified_fact: Randomized double-blind 110-person study reported 94.5% versus 16.4% healing at six weeks.
sources.limit: Old study; control was lidocaine/hydrocortisone, not modern diltiazem or nitroglycerin; no guarantee of replication.

sources.title: Nifedipine versus diltiazem anal-fissure trial
sources.verified_fact: 110 patients with mixed acute/chronic fissures; healing 70.9% with nifedipine versus 67.3% with diltiazem, with both improving symptoms.
sources.limit: Different lidocaine concentration from Antrolin; not superiority and not proof of FDA efficacy or foreign-product equivalence.

sources.title: Italian official Antrolin manufacturing variation
sources.verified_fact: Official notice identifies Neopharmed Gentili as Antrolin authorization holder and New.Fa.Dem as manufacturing/quality/release site.
sources.limit: Shows an actual existing product/holder, not territorial rights availability, dossier usability, FDA acceptance or price.

sources.title: RECTIV FDA prescribing information
sources.verified_fact: Nitroglycerin ointment is approved for moderate-to-severe pain associated with chronic anal fissure.
sources.limit: Existing comparator; label does not establish nifedipine's superiority or proposed development requirements.

sources.title: VEN307 phaseIII results
sources.verified_fact: Sponsor reported no significant primary pain benefit over placebo in the second pivotal diltiazem trial involving 434 subjects.
sources.limit: Related mechanism and indication, not a nifedipine trial; informative about pain/placebo and development risk.

sources.title: VEN307 license termination after FDA feedback
sources.verified_fact: Assembly terminated the VEN307 license after FDA said approval chances were unclear without another trial and after a strategy change.
sources.limit: Historical analogy only; not current FDA guidance for nifedipine.

sources.title: Rectal tacrolimus placebo-controlled refractory-proctitis trial
sources.verified_fact: Clinical response occurred in 8/11 tacrolimus versus 1/10 placebo recipients; trial stopped early after interim analysis.
sources.limit: Very small early-stopped trial; ointment cannot be treated as identical to every proposed suppository.

sources.title: Tacrolimus versus beclomethasone suppositories in refractory proctitis
sources.verified_fact: 85-person multicenter trial found clinical responses of 63% versus 59%, without tacrolimus superiority.
sources.limit: Supports activity but weakens an assumed superiority/value premium over inexpensive topical steroid care.

sources.title: Tacrolimus suppositories observational refractory-proctitis study
sources.verified_fact: Retrospective 43-person series reported remission signals, substantial systemic drug levels, and one reversible acute kidney injury.
sources.limit: Uncontrolled; explicitly prevents assuming local delivery eliminates systemic immunosuppressant risk.

sources.title: TRITON ondansetron IBS-D randomized trial
sources.verified_fact: 80 of planned 400 randomized; composite response was 40.5% versus 27.9%, p=0.19; stool consistency improved.
sources.limit: Underrecruited and primary composite nonsignificant; stool effects do not prove abdominal-pain or regulatory composite benefit.

sources.title: Oral versus topical minoxidil randomized male hair-loss trial
sources.verified_fact: 90 men randomized; oral treatment was not superior on primary terminal-hair-density outcomes and caused more hypertrichosis/headache.
sources.limit: Not an equivalence trial; findings concern immediate-release oral article, not proprietary extended release.

sources.title: Veradermics VDPHL01 phaseIII 304 sponsor results
sources.verified_fact: Sponsor reports positive phaseIII extended-release oral-minoxidil results and over 1,000 participants across two registration-directed studies.
sources.limit: Sponsor topline report; not approval, not an investment offer, and not evidence that a different formulation matches it.

sources.title: Low-dose naltrexone fibromyalgia randomized trial
sources.verified_fact: 99 women randomized; no significant pain benefit over placebo at 12 weeks.
sources.limit: Does not rule out all naltrexone indications; directly weakens unselected fibromyalgia thesis.

sources.title: INNOVA low-dose naltrexone fibromyalgia randomized trial
sources.verified_fact: 98 women randomized; no clinically meaningful pain-related benefit over placebo over short or longer follow-up.
sources.limit: Independent negative exact-use evidence; not a reason to invent a responder subgroup post hoc.

sources.title: COVID-OUT metformin and LongCOVID follow-up
sources.verified_fact: Acute outpatient metformin was associated with lower subsequent LongCOVID diagnosis in randomized follow-up: 6.3% versus 10.4%, hazard ratio 0.59.
sources.limit: Prevention after acute infection in specified enrolled population, not treatment of established LongCOVID; current baseline risk may differ.

sources.title: Oral tranexamic acid randomized melasma study
sources.verified_fact: 44 randomized; three-month melasma improvement exceeded placebo but much advantage diminished after stopping.
sources.limit: Small trial cannot quantify rare thrombotic risk; durability, generic capture and chronic use remain issues.

sources.title: Topical sirolimus randomized vascular-anomalies trial
sources.verified_fact: 50 participants across vascular-anomaly phenotypes; primary photographic-improvement endpoint was not significant; selected secondary/post-hoc size measures favored treatment.
sources.limit: Mixed population includes only 14 lymphatic-malformation patients; does not validate an exact microcystic-lymphatic indication.

sources.title: TOPICAL microcystic lymphatic-malformation trial protocol
sources.verified_fact: Protocol describes within-person randomized topical-sirolimus versus vehicle evaluation in cutaneous microcystic lymphatic malformations.
sources.limit: Protocol is not results; trial status/results require a focused check before new duplicate work.

sources.title: HYFTOR current label
sources.verified_fact: Nobelpharma's sirolimus gel is an approved topical product for facial angiofibroma associated with tuberous sclerosis.
sources.limit: Different indication and potentially different presentation; product existence does not establish lymphatic-malformation efficacy or access.

sources.title: Ambroxol Parkinson dementia randomized trial
sources.verified_fact: 55 randomized; target engagement was demonstrated but no difference in primary or secondary clinical outcomes was found.
sources.limit: Target engagement is not cognitive efficacy; results do not by themselves establish a responsive GBA subgroup.

sources.title: ALTAR methenamine recurrentUTI trial
sources.verified_fact: 240 randomized; standard methenamine met the prespecified noninferiority criterion versus daily antibiotics.
sources.limit: Evidence concerns existing standard presentation, not a proposed once-daily modified-release formulation; open-label design and margin matter.

sources.title: Mavoglurant cocaine-use-disorder phaseII trial
sources.verified_fact: 68 adults randomized; reduced self-reported cocaine-use days and supportive urine findings were reported.
sources.limit: Small short trial; large-effect posterior probability was much weaker than any-effect probability. Not a repayment probability.

sources.title: STALICLA mavoglurant exclusive license announcement
sources.verified_fact: STALICLA announced worldwide rights from Novartis for substance-use, neurodevelopmental and other indications, with undisclosed upfront/equity and contingent milestones.
sources.limit: Historical transaction, not available current price. Headline milestone total is not asset price or expected investor payoff.

sources.title: STOPFOP European Commission project report
sources.verified_fact: Project report says 17 participants completed randomized and open-label phases; further data analysis was required before public efficacy conclusions.
sources.limit: Completion and investigator-reported benefit do not establish controlled efficacy; no published numerical efficacy result retrieved.

sources.title: STOPFOP sponsor and study record
sources.verified_fact: Amsterdam UMC is sponsor; registry identifies EU/AstraZeneca funding and ongoing, recruitment-ended status.
sources.limit: Registry status and completed phases can coexist with extensions; no assumption of an available asset or transferable dataset.

sources.title: Levodopa/carbidopa MCT8 clinical report
sources.verified_fact: Earlier MCT8 report contains six paired systematic treatment assessments, with movement-related improvement.
sources.limit: Uncontrolled; eleven phenotyped people are not eleven independently evaluated treatment responders.

sources.title: Second levodopa/carbidopa MCT8 clinical report
sources.verified_fact: Second report describes ten phenotyped males; repo full-body audit identifies nine evaluable treatment courses with mixed functional outcomes.
sources.limit: Do not pool publications as independent unique patients; neurological symptomatic claim is narrower than disease modification.

sources.title: EMCITATE FDA label
sources.verified_fact: Tiratricol's labeled MCT8 indication concerns peripheral thyrotoxicosis.
sources.limit: Does not answer levodopa adjunct motor-benefit question; appropriate background care remains required.

sources.title: BAART-DFU timolol trial registry
sources.verified_fact: Registry reports 48 randomized and 12-week complete closure in 8/21 timolol versus 7/27 placebo recipients.
sources.limit: Post-hoc analysis of selected healed wounds is not a recurrence or complete-healing efficacy demonstration.

sources.title: Topical erlotinib KRT16 primary letter
sources.verified_fact: Two related people with KRT16 Arg127Cys underwent opposite-foot comparisons and later uncontrolled extension with clinical/pain improvement.
sources.limit: Inherited full-text audit; author copy failed fresh retrieval. Keratolytic co-treatment and formulation matter.
sources.lineage_note: The author conference report describes randomized blinded opposite-limb comparison in the same two cases; it is not independent clinical replication.

sources.title: Other keratoderma EGFR-inhibitor reports
sources.verified_fact: Repository primary-text audit reports inconclusive or unsuccessful topical erlotinib in two other patients.
